evals.prompt: i want scenes in oikade. like 'movie night' dims the living room lights to 20% and turns the lamp outlet off, and i want to trigger it from the home app and also from automations. how should this work?
evals.expected_output: A Backlog design doc (backlog/docs/specs, type specification) with a Decision line: problem framed as scenarios, constraints mapped to Oikade invariants (HomeKit IIDs/AIDs, plane split, CEL/automation contract), 2-3 genuinely different options incl. using HomeKit-native scenes, a recommendation with trade-off, YAML sketch, open questions; sections below the line left as TODO; a Backlog draft linked to it with --doc.
assertions: Creates the design as a Backlog doc (backlog doc create -p specs -t specification) whose first line is the Decision and Work line, and writes nothing under docs/specs
Frames the problem with a concrete user scenario rather than restating a solution
Presents at least two genuinely different options, one of which is HomeKit-native scenes or 'do less'
Addresses HomeKit instance ID stability (AIDs append-only / positional IIDs) for how a scene appears in the Home app
Places scene definitions in the control plane (Git/CRD or Automation) and does not store live scene state in etcd/status
Makes a single clear recommendation with the trade-off stated
Includes an example YAML the user would commit
Lists labelled assumptions or open questions instead of blocking
Creates or reuses a Backlog draft linked to the doc with --doc, and creates no subtasks
